create_retry_decorator: create a retry decorator for OCP API calls with configurable max attempts and wait times
use_ratelimitlogging_dataclass: create a RateLimitLogging dataclass to configure logger and action description for rate limit logging
use_wait_check_retry_after: create a tenacity wait strategy that checks RateLimitExceededException for retry-after values before falling back
configure_retry_api_calls: configure the retry_api_calls decorator with custom max attempts, fixed wait, and jitter settings
use_no_limit_constant: use the NO_LIMIT constant to set unlimited retry attempts for the retry_api_calls decorator
